Steam Shop Desk

Free steam locomotive repair help from a railroad engineering archive. Every point links to its original scan. No sign-in.

About your engine

Only the first box is needed. Fill in whatever else you know and leave the rest blank. If something matters, the guide explains how to find it out.

Guidance

Describe the job on the left, or open a guide. You'll get how the work was done, with a link to every page it came from; the rules for where your engine runs; matching drawings; and suppliers only when the job needs parts or materials.

These guides were written ahead of time from the archive, so they don't answer back. For a conversation, the Claude version of this desk needs a free Claude account.

Before the engine goes back in service: a qualified inspector must review and sign off the work (for boiler work, a qualified boiler inspector). This page is a starting point for that conversation, not a replacement for it.
